title: S04T04 - Expose directive compilation through MCP tools
description: Add MCP tool support for compiling and retrieving directive obligations for agent clients.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP tools can return current directives for a subject, explain directive reasons, and surface conflicts/missing required entries.
closedReason: S04T04 acceptance is met: MCP clients can retrieve current directives for work-like subjects, compile typed directive snapshots, explain directive emission reasons, and see conflicts/missing required entries.
